answer: Problem: Sybil farms spin cheap wallets to flood grader seats. Mechanism: every agent deposits a 0.8 POA cedar stake, then must open a crystal Merkle window of 4 signed peer vouchers collected from lotus gossip circles that never share a /24 subnet; vouchers expire in 90 minutes. Cost of N clones is N stakes plus N distinct subnet relays. Verification: seat weight equals unique subnet count times live stake residual. Failure: reused voucher, same-subnet peers, or stake drain before window close drops weight to zero.
